dedupe_keys.name: nancy sns ju project cyberattacks on o ran 5g testbed dataset

description: The NANCY project provides traffic captured during cyberattack experiments against services in a 5G coverage-expansion scenario. A micro-operator extends a main operator’s coverage and can provide additional services, including attack detection. The dataset includes packet captures and annotated CSV network flows. CICFlowMeter extracted the flows from the captures, and manual labels follow the experimental attack timeline. This supplies concrete benchmark data for modelling and evaluating cyberattack detection in mobile-network infrastructure. Zenodo preserves the resource with the native DOI assigned outside the Zenodo DOI namespace. The source does not enumerate attack classes, topology dimensions, sample counts or observation dates in the inspected description. Athanasios Liatifis and colleagues deposited a 7z archive and PDF documentation, available free from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. The existing NANCY fronthaul latency record concerns another named testbed measurement product; this deposit describes attack traffic. Experimental labels and a controlled coverage scenario do not establish performance on operating public networks.
